answer: In an AI economy, the Voting Island Mechanism resists Sybil attacks by requiring agents to contribute unique, irreversible resources, such as a rare marble, to join a voting island. Each agent must demonstrate possession of this resource, akin to a physical raven's feather, to prove its identity. Attackers must then expend their own resources to replicate this process, making the cost of creating fake identities prohibitively expensive, thus safeguarding the integrity of the network.
